title: Career Profile Unknown Semantics & Fallback Elimination Contract
principles: User facts must only be established by explicit user input.
Missing profile fields must remain null or UNKNOWN.
Absence of reservationCategory must NEVER default to UR.
Absence of isPwBD or isExServiceman must NEVER default to false.
Absence of experienceMonths must NEVER default to 0.

matchingEngineBehaviorOnUnknown.missingDateOfBirth: Returns status MISSING_FIELD, prompts user for DOB
matchingEngineBehaviorOnUnknown.missingReservationCategory: Returns status VACANCIES_PENDING_RESERVATION_DATA for vacancies, prompts user for category
matchingEngineBehaviorOnUnknown.missingQualification: Returns status MISSING_FIELD, prompts user for qualification
matchingEngineBehaviorOnUnknown.missingPwBD: Disallows matching PWBD reserved vacancies without assuming candidate is non-PwBD
matchingEngineBehaviorOnUnknown.missingExServiceman: Disallows matching EX_SERVICEMAN reserved vacancies without assuming candidate is civilian
